title: urgent problem - no internet
body: I am the user y8v. I am locked out of my main account (right now) due to my Arch laptop dying (frick china), and I can only post this here. Two days ago, my Thinkpad P50 stopped working. I decided to flash Arch (full install) to a Sandisk Cruzer Glide. After three attempts (no archinstall), I successfully installed Arch Linux from a windows box using VirtualBox. After getting it working yesterday, I decided to start customization today. I installed XFCE4, and then I went looking for a Desktop Manager. I found "ly", I thought it looked cool, and I installed it. I couldn't figure out how to use it, so i uninstalled it (I figured out how to later, but by then it was too late). I decided to then install SDDM, but when I tried to, it couldn't find any mirrors with the files. I checked, and somehow the system was entirely disconnected from the internet. iw could not connect to my network, with the message "command failed: No such device (-19)", and nmcli + nmtui both said "Error: could nor create NMClient object: Could not connect: Connection refused.". dmesg said I was missing some sort of "b43-firmware" thingie, which was in the AUR, and I had to obtain all those files my self, which involved me having to get the PKGBUILD, the code, and "b43-fwcutter". Side note: when I used the PKGBUILD, i replaced "$pkgdir"/usr/lib/some-dir-iforgot-the-name-of with only the directory name, ommiting the $pkgdir part cause i ddidn't know what that variable was, but dmesg didn't complain after that. After I installed the missing firmware, nothing happened, other than dmesg not complaining. All the error messages are still the same, and ethernet doesn't work either. Please help, I have spent 4 hours on this and nothings change, do I have to reinstall arch? if not what do i do? A nother Side note: I may have used iw wrong lol Another another side note: I ran sudo ip link set enp1s0 up, and then when I ran ip addr again, it said up, but I coulddn't use the internet, andf when I removed th ethernet, it said off again I redirected dmesg output to a file, just gotta find my other usb drive to transfer it I just found the usb, it was already plugged into the computer im
